name: Lowest-Cost Assisted Living Finder
description: Find lower-cost assisted living and memory care options in Massachusetts through MassHealth, region flexibility, care-plan changes, and nonprofit funding.

steps.text: I'll ask you a few quick questions to find lower-cost assisted living or memory care options for your family in Massachusetts. All guidance is preliminary — confirm eligibility with the relevant agency or elder-law professional.
Does your loved one have insurance through MassHealth?
Which monthly income range is closest for your loved one?
Do they have savings or assets that could affect benefits eligibility?

options.label: Some savings, home, or retirement funds

steps.text: Is the older adult or their spouse a veteran?
How far could family reasonably drive for a lower-priced facility?
Is secured memory care or overnight supervision a safety need?

options.label: No, standard assisted living may fit

steps.title: Preliminary cost-lowering guidance
steps.text: Based on your answers, here are the most relevant paths to explore for reducing monthly care costs:
items: Call MassHealth or a SHINE counselor to confirm eligibility before assuming private-pay is the only option. Ask specifically about the Frail Elder Waiver, Group Adult Foster Care, and PACE programs.
Screen for public and nonprofit help: local ASAP/Area Agency on Aging, Council on Aging, SHINE, veterans Aid & Attendance, respite grants, and Alzheimer's Association supports.
Compare lower-priced Massachusetts regions within your stated drive radius. Central and Western Massachusetts typically price below Boston/inner-suburb rates for similar care levels.
Ask facilities about manageable care-plan changes: smaller room type, family-provided transportation, pharmacy packaging, adult day health, or shared suite to reduce monthly add-ons.
Do not cut secured memory care, overnight supervision, medication management, or transfer support if those are safety needs — focus on funding and region flexibility first.
Request the facility's care-level fee schedule, move-in fees, and the conditions that would trigger a higher care-level charge before signing any agreement.

cta.label: Find facilities that fit this plan
